attempts.cause: Initial wrapper cast null Word.Application.Hwnd to IntPtr. No PDF; DOCX unchanged. Original receipt retained as WORD_RENDER_RECEIPT_R05.json.

Retry wrapper was launched without preserving the returned session handle; a same-scope R05 COM process appeared without a terminal receipt. Exact R05 PowerShell/Word PIDs were inspected and stopped; no PDF was present.

The same wrapper was inadvertently launched again while an earlier render remained unobserved. The active tool session was interrupted and only its exact R05 COM process was terminated; no pre-existing Word process was touched.
Switched to the already successful 0007 R12 pattern: exact SHA precheck, wait for unique new WINWORD PID, hidden/read-only open, explicit export, candidate post-hash, and owned PID cleanup.

root_cause: The first script assumed Hwnd would be non-null; subsequent command orchestration failed to retain/check session handles, causing duplicate same-scope COM attempts. Corrected by using unique PID ownership and the known-good bounded renderer script.
next_prevention: Do not issue another same-scope renderer while the existing exec session is active; poll its session_id and progress file before deciding whether to retry.
